title: Arjuna Vishada Yoga
translation: Observing the Armies on the Battlefield of Kurukshetra
summary: The first chapter describes the distress of Arjuna upon seeing his relatives, teachers, and friends on the opposing side of the battlefield. Overwhelmed by compassion and confusion about his duty, he refuses to fight.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः |
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ||
verses.translation: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjay, after my sons and the sons of Pandu assembled in the place of pilgrimage at Kurukshetra, desiring to fight, what did they do?
verses.transliteration:
dharma-kṣetre kuru-kṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāś caiva kim akurvata sañjaya
verses.meaning: Dharmakshetre - in the field of dharma; Kurukshetre - in the field of the Kurus; samavetāḥ - assembled; yuyutsavaḥ - desiring to fight...

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा ।
आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् ।।
verses.translation: Sanjay said: On observing the Pandava army standing in military formation, King Duryodhana approached his teacher Dronacharya and spoke the following words.
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca
dṛṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṃ vyūḍhaṃ duryodhanas tadā
ācāryam upasaṅgamya rājā vacanam abravīt
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said - Sanjay said; dṛṣṭvā - having seen; tu - but; pāṇḍava-anīkam - the soldiers of the Pandavas; vyūḍham - arranged in a military phalanx...
